hero.headline: A Track Record Built on Iconic Outcomes
hero.subtext: We have advised on some of the most consequential technology transactions of the past three decades. A selection of completed mandates is shown below — many are confidential at client request.

transactions.tagline: Virtual Care, Real Value, Seamless Transition
transactions.description: PlushCare's virtual care, now integrated with Accolade, is transforming how millions access healthcare — combining digital convenience with holistic support.
outcomes_seller: Premium exit valued up to $450M
Team continuity and product vision maintained within Accolade
Access to Accolade's 9M+ members and employer partnerships
New career and growth opportunities for the team
outcomes_investors: Strong returns via cash, stock, and earnouts
Smooth, certain deal with strategic acquirer
Enhanced reputation as PlushCare scales nationwide

transactions.tagline: From Startup Kitchen to Industry Table
transactions.description: Gobble's 15-minute meal kits, now powered by Intelligent Foods' $1.5B+ production capacity, set a new standard for D2C meal solutions.
outcomes_seller: Nine-figure, all-cash exit
Founder and key leaders retained in senior roles
Gobble and Sunbasket brands remain distinct
Expanded reach to 40M+ households
outcomes_investors: Smooth, certain transaction with strategic acquirer
Enhanced reputation as Gobble's innovation scales

transactions.description: Blyncsy's AI, now integrated with Bentley's iTwin ecosystem, is transforming how infrastructure owners monitor and maintain roads.
outcomes_seller: Premium exit validating AI innovation
Team continuity and product vision preserved
Access to Bentley's global reach and iTwin platform
outcomes_investors: Strong returns in competitive AI market
Seamless transaction with proven, strategic acquirer
Enhanced reputation as Blyncsy's technology scales worldwide

transactions.description: Vertical software platform with embedded payments for high-volume hospitality venues. Ignatious unlocked Netsuke's growth inflection point through a premium strategic exit.
outcomes_seller: Unlocks growth inflection point
Provides additional go-to-market scaling resources
Enables rapid scale-up through organic and inorganic growth

transactions.tagline: Predictive Maintenance AI at Automotive Scale
transactions.description: Predictive maintenance AI software platform for automotive OEMs and fleets. The acquisition established an AI-driven software business unit for the acquirer.
outcomes_seller: Establishes AI-driven software business unit
Accelerates global rollout of predictive maintenance capabilities
Creates upsell and cross-sell opportunities for next-gen mobility

transactions.description: eCommerce enablement software platform. The transaction freed up capital for Destiny's core supply chain business while establishing a standalone commerce-as-a-service offering.
outcomes_seller: Frees up capital for core supply chain business
Establishes standalone partner for commerce-as-a-service offering
Streamlines decision making and profitability
